instruction.text: Complete the sentence by writing the correct spelling of the word in the gap.

atoms.b: I enjoy the ((convenience)) of living near the train station.
atoms.finishSound: I enjoy the convenience of living near the train station.

atoms.b: She read the ((explanation)) of the exhibit.
atoms.finishSound: She read the explanation of the exhibit.

atoms.b: They got into bed and ((immediately)) fell asleep.
atoms.finishSound: They got into bed and immediately fell asleep.

atoms.b: This is the ((opportunity)) of a lifetime.
atoms.finishSound: This is the opportunity of a lifetime.

atoms.b: ((Pronunciation)) is important when learning a foreign language.
atoms.finishSound: Pronunciation is important when learning a foreign language.
